headline: Typewriting Machine Now On Sale; Remington Offers Device to Write by Key
dispatch: The Remington No. 1 typewriter went on public sale today, the first commercially available machine of its kind. Built on the chassis of a sewing machine by the Remington arms company, the device allows users to produce printed text by striking lettered keys. Merchants expect the invention to transform correspondence and office work across the country.
answer: The Remington No. 1 typewriter goes on sale, 1874
